clock_scopes.old_weight_load_and_restore: captured weight helper including NPZ read and tensor restore

baseline_runtime_admission_scope: Old local audit startup has no current full-installation verifier. Full unchanged-runtime admission/bookend is separate evidence; do not treat startup clock scopes as equivalent.
